# Shantanu Acharya - Lead Enterprise Product Designer
> Lead Enterprise Product Designer with 11+ years of experience architecting complex B2B SaaS platforms, enterprise operational systems, and cross-platform workflows. Specialized in information architecture and data-dense dashboards. Based in Pune, India.

## Key Case Studies & Projects
- [OpsBridge Exception Management Platform](https://shantanuacharya.in/pdfs/cs1-shantanuacharya-x7k9p2m.pdf): Enterprise Operations UX. Designed a real-time exception management platform connecting field and operations teams through shared visibility, workflows, and faster decisions.
- [AuditIQ Platform](https://shantanuacharya.in/pdfs/cs2-shantanuacharya-v4b8n1q.pdf): Audit & Compliance UX. Redesigned enterprise audit workflows with structured control tracking, faster scanability, and operational accountability.
- [KPMG Tax Navigator](https://shantanuacharya.in/pdfs/cs3-shantanuacharya-j9f3c8z.pdf): Mobile Product Design. Designed a public-facing mobile experience for curated tax insights, personalised discovery, and enterprise-aligned usability.
- [MindMeld Wellness App Concept](https://shantanuacharya.in/pdfs/cs4-shantanuacharya-t2w5r7y.pdf): Empathy-Led UX. Crafted an emotional wellness experience with frictionless daily check-ins and empathy-driven information architecture.
- [Nomad Notes Travel Website](https://shantanuacharya.in/pdfs/cs5-shantanuacharya-h6d4m9p.pdf): Responsive Web UX. Created a responsive travel experience focused on mobile-first exploration, destination discoverability, and visual simplicity.

## Design Philosophy & Expertise
- Information Architecture First: Organising complex workflows and high-density information into intuitive, scalable user experiences.
- Clarity Within Complexity: Prioritising usability, scanability, and efficient task completion for enterprise systems without oversimplifying workflows.
- Cross-Platform Consistency: Ensuring experiences remain consistent, adaptable, and user-focused across enterprise dashboards, responsive websites, and mobile applications.
